# herdr-box

The herdr terminal-multiplexer server box (fedora:43 base) composing the
herdr candy (pinned herdr v0.8.2 binary + supervised headless server) and
the socat bridge (TCP:8095 to the server's NDJSON unix socket). Host-side
consumers — the herdr: check verb (ResolveEndpoint over the reverse
channel) and `charly herdr --endpoint tcp://host:8095` — probe the venue
through the bridge. `check-herdr-pod` is the disposable R10 bed: deploy,
probe both surfaces, fresh update, teardown.

## Build / deploy

```
charly box build herdr
charly config herdr        # or compose 'herdr' into any app
```

## The R10 bed

```
charly check run check-herdr-pod
```
